t: This is Caxton Street in the City of Westminster. It runs between Buckingham Gate in the west and Broadway in the east. Vandon Street joins it on the north side, and Palmer Street crosses it. The street takes its name from William Caxton, the English merchant, diplomat and writer. He's thought to be the first person to introduce a printing press into England, in 1476, which made him the first English retailer of printed books. So as you walk along, you're on a street named for the man who brought printing to England.
